verdict.rationale: Ramp publishes a documented public Developer API with machine-readable docs and an OAuth 2.0 scope model. A probe confirmed a live OpenAPI document with 174 paths, and a getting-started flow covers creating an app and calling the Transactions API. Endpoint docs span bills, virtual cards (Vault), custom records, AI usage and spend controls, alongside a sandbox for safe testing, so every element of the story is covered with first-party docs and independent probe corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: You'll create an access token and call the Transactions API to retrieve transaction data.
a parseable OpenAPI document titled "Ramp Developer API" (v1) with 174 documented paths, including /developer/v1/transactions
Ramp uses OAuth 2.0 for secure API access, providing granular permission control through scopes and supporting multiple authorization flows for different use cases
A working POST /bills request that resolves every required UUID upfront.
In your Ramp account, go to Company → Developer (you'll need admin access). Click Create New App.
